name: Randomized Littlestone Dimension / VC Dimension
details: For every finite binary class, $\mathrm{RL}(\mathcal H)\geq\tfrac12\mathrm{VC}(\mathcal H)$.
proof: If a d-set is VC-shattered, label every level i of a complete depth-d tree by its ith point. The resulting tree is shattered and every root-to-leaf path has length d. Its uniform-walk average depth is d, so the defining factor one half gives $\mathrm{RL}(\mathcal H)\ge d/2$. Maximize over d.
